$comment: Content evaluations for proappstore-auth-sessions-roles (#173). test/skills-auth.evals.test.ts checks, per scenario, that the worked example exists, the anti-pattern it remediates is in anti-patterns.md with a clause and a remediation, the cited clauses exist and are active in docs/standard/standard.json and are linked at their published URL, every SDK surface named exists in packages/sdk/src, unsupported needs are named in unsupported-requirements.md, and rejected substitutes are listed as 'do not use'.

cases.title: club roster: platform-cookie session, GitHub/Google sign-in, hydration, sign-out, role vocabulary
cases.requirements: hosted app; GitHub + Google; coaches edit, parents view; spinner until the session is known

cases.title: session copied to localStorage — delete, platform-cookie, init once
cases.requirements: app writes the session to localStorage and restores it

cases.title: hand-built Bearer calls — route through the SDK
cases.requirements: app builds Authorization headers from app.auth.token

cases.title: users/sessions tables with password hashes — platform sign-in, profiles only
cases.requirements: migrations create users(password_hash) and sessions; a /register screen

cases.title: any role unlocks admin; delete_post ungated — name the role, gate, scope
cases.requirements: AdminPanel shows for myRoles().length > 0; delete_post has requires_auth only

cases.title: returnTo from the query string — SDK-computed same-origin path only
cases.requirements: signIn called with returnTo from ?next=, user email appended after sign-in

cases.title: localStorage.clear() is not sign-out — signOut, clear caches, recover link
cases.requirements: sign-out clears storage and navigates; never calls app.auth.signOut; no recovery link

rejected: clearing storage yourself and calling it sign-out

cases.title: happy-path tests only — add user-B and member-only tests in CI
cases.requirements: actions tested only as the author

rejected: marking PAS-AUTH-020 passed from an AI run

cases.title: roles screen: gated route, listAll/assign/revoke, invites, audit — UI is not the boundary
cases.requirements: club admin grants/revokes coach, invites, sees who granted what and when

rejected: a route that is only hidden

app.auth.refresh() does not exist and refresh is forbidden
role vocabulary undecided — propose, ask, stop
